present_continuous_prefixes.description: 1st person singular present continuous (Ni + ku -> Nkhu)

past_tense_prefixes.description: 1st person singular remote past (Ni + ka -> Nkha)

subject_verb_inversion.description: Transforms singular class 1 subject prefixes combined with present tense 'waku-' followed by a verb root into English SVO order

sentence_negation_yayi.description: Captures standard present tense continuous negative statements ending with 'yayi'

sentence_negation_chara.description: Captures absolute negative or future tense negative statements ending with 'chara'

yes_no_questions.description: Handles question formations initialized by the 'kasi' marker

locative_prepositions.description: Translates structural locative noun classes into spatial context expressions

possessive_alignment.description: Reverses the Tumbuka Noun + Possessive structure to English Possessive + Noun structure (e.g., 'mwana wane' -> 'my child')
